📖 How to use

      
  1. Pick light or dark mode and a background color.
  2. Set the shadow distance, blur and intensity.
  3. Choose raised (outset) or pressed (inset) shadows.
  4. Preview both card and button live, then copy the CSS.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does it style my whole page?
It works on the element you apply it to; the generator previews it on both a raised card and a pressed-in button so you can see both states.
How do I make an indented/pressed button?
Pick "Pressed" from the shadow mode to invert the shadows, which reads as an indented button.
Which background colors work best?
Neumorphism relies on subtle light and dark shadows — pick a mid-tone background color for the effect to read clearly.
